name: micro-frontend-demo
description: Micro-frontend e-commerce demo — Vite Module Federation, React 19, shell routing, cross-MFE events

scripts.install:all: npm install && npm install --prefix product-app && npm install --prefix cart-app && npm install --prefix shell
scripts.dev:product: npm run build --prefix product-app && concurrently -n watch,serve -c blue "npm run build:watch --prefix product-app" "npm run preview --prefix product-app"
scripts.dev:cart: npm run build --prefix cart-app && concurrently -n watch,serve -c green "npm run build:watch --prefix cart-app" "npm run preview --prefix cart-app"
scripts.dev:all: concurrently -n product,cart,shell -c blue,green,magenta "npm run dev:product" "npm run dev:cart" "wait-on http://localhost:3001/assets/remoteEntry.js http://localhost:3002/assets/remoteEntry.js && npm run dev:shell"
scripts.build:all: npm run build --prefix product-app && npm run build --prefix cart-app && npm run build --prefix shell
scripts.lint:all: npm run lint --prefix product-app && npm run lint --prefix cart-app && npm run lint --prefix shell
